526:t_10:26.en:
$$アル$$
「That's wonderful. I would also like to think about what comes after the Sergeant is discharged someday, and learn how to support that.」

526:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If it comes to that, I, a dimensional merchant of some standing, can offer all of you advice.」

526:t_10:28.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I understand the situation. Request support for this unit.」

526:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Society is built on connections between people. In other words, communication skills are among the most valued abilities in social life.」

526:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And the first element of smooth communication is affability.」

526:t_10:33.en:
$$アル$$
「That is a quality both Ensign $$レド$$ and Sergeant $$相良$$ lack.」

526:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Supporting that is also your duty. First, let me set an example!」

526:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's give it our all again today...!」

527:t_000:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「$$ダナン$$ is docking at $$ニケーロ$$ Island.」

527:t_000:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Everything is going as expected so far... The $$クォーター$$'s diversion seems to have worked.」

527:t_000:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「That base... is that $$アマルガム$$'s stronghold?」

527:t_001:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「As expected of $$テッサ$$. To pinpoint $$アマルガム$$'s base using only the information $$宗介$$ gathered in $$ナムサク$$.」

527:t_001:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「As for that, my power also...」

527:t_001:2.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Don't be tactless. You'll lower a man's value.」

527:t_001:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「On top of that, the power-up for our M9s is perfect too!」

527:t_001:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「The '《$$妖精の目$$》' fitted to your unit is like an ultra-high-performance sensor that detects the field around enemy units and their drive status.」

527:t_001:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Combine this with my sniping and it's a sure one-shot kill!」

527:t_001:6.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「This is bad. Looks like the contest for $c's number-one sniper is going to go against me.」

527:t_001:7.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$ベン$$'s Falke has had its joints reinforced so it can withstand even more reckless maneuvers than before.」

527:t_001:8.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I can bring my art to its fullest.」

527:t_001:9.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「So that incredible close-combat tactic gets even stronger.」

527:t_001:11.en:
$$マオ$$
「And the ITCC-5 on my M9 can control unmanned units through its data link. With it, I'll form Sis $$マオ$$'s personal guard!」

527:t_001:12.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Combined with my Ghost, we could pull off a disruption tactic across air and ground.」

527:t_001:13.en:
$$レド$$
「But our strength is not only that.」

527:t_002:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Naturally. It's the day $$宗介$$ has waited so long for.」

527:t_002:2.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
(I get $$宗介$$, but $n too?)

527:t_002:3.en:
$$クラン$$
(That guy... all that feigning ignorance about Miss $$スズネ$$ - maybe he had feelings for her all along...)

527:t_002:4.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Burning one's fighting spirit for the one you love.」

527:t_002:5.en:
$$桂$$
「I like that kind of thing! I'll cheer you on with everything I've got!」

527:t_002:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$宗介$$, $n. Leave the backup to us.」

527:t_002:7.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Be careful. The interception force is coming out.」

527:t_003:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「They're pouring out one after another!」

527:t_003:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$クロウ$$! Your honey's here!」

527:t_003:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The only thing I love is money.」

527:t_003:4.en:
$n
「$$クロウ$$... I'm ashamed just listening to you...」

527:t_003:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Ugh... Hearing that from you too really stings.」

527:t_003:6.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「If you're talking about old ties, the usual guy is here too.」

527:t_003:7.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$キリコ$$! $$シャッコ$$, $$カレン$$, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$! The day I settle things with you has come!」

527:t_003:8.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Isn't the red $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$-equipped type here?」

527:t_003:9.en:
$$カレン$$
「And there's no gold-plated punk either, so we won't get outpowered!」

527:t_003:11.en:
$$カレン$$
「You're 'not even on my radar,' as $$エスター$$ put it!」

527:t_003:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't have time for small fry! We take down the enemy base in one go!」

527:t_003:15.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「I apologize that the enemy's swift deployment delayed the escape of you and your party.」

527:t_003:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「Don't worry about it. This much is within my expectations.」

527:t_003:18.en:
$$レナード$$
「Conveniently, the transport of the ARX-8 arrived in time.」

527:t_003:19.en:
$$レナード$$
「By crushing it right before their eyes, I'll have them learn what giving up means.」

527:t_004:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's about time. It's a bit like a show, though...」

527:t_005:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, be careful! The enemy's main force has appeared!」

527:t_006:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「The $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$-equipped types are out!」

527:t_006:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「With this much force here, it's certain that smug silver-haired bastard is here too!」

527:t_007:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Cover me. I'm going to break through.」

527:t_008:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Soo sorry! That's my strike zone!」

527:t_010:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Too fragile, far too fragile... And this is the white $$ミスリル$$ unit that gave me so much trouble...」

527:t_010:1.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Just kidding! A hollow mockup without a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$, so naturally that's the result!」

527:t_010:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't decide it's over on your own...!」
